title: Eval Dataset
description: The retrieval eval set: hand-written Eval Cases, each labelled with the Gold Locators where its answer lives (ADR-0027, ADR-0029). Relational checks the schema can't express -- unique case ids, and Gold Locators that exist in the ingested Chunks -- are enforced by eval/'s tests.

dataset_version.description: Bumped on any edit to the cases, and pinned in every eval run report so scores are only ever compared against the dataset that produced them (ADR-0030).

goldLocator.description: A (document_id, locator) pair naming where an answer lives in the source Document's own structure -- deliberately never a Chunk id, so it survives re-chunking (ADR-0027).

id.description: q01, q02, ... -- stable across dataset versions so run reports can be compared case by case.

phrasing.description: Whether the question reuses the source passage's wording or deliberately avoids it -- reported separately to expose lexical overlap bias (ADR-0029).

gold_locators.description: A case is a hit if any one of these matches a retrieved Chunk (ADR-0028). Empty only for unanswerable cases.

superseded_locators.description: Supersession cases only: the older, superseded Document's equivalent of the Gold Locators, recorded but not scored as a hit.

answer_quote.description: Verbatim text from the source, for a human to sanity-check the label. Never used for matching.
